title: Muse Ideally Located Condo with City View & Gym
description:
Stay in an ideally located downtown Nashville condo with city views, a private balcony, central air conditioning, elevator access, fast Wi-Fi, and an in-building gym. The two-bedroom, two-bathroom home sleeps six with two king beds and two single beds. Enjoy a full kitchen, dedicated workspace, and nearby coin laundry during your stay.

The space
Experience the best of Music City, USA from this brand new second-floor condo ideally situated within a mile of the top local attractions. This upscale home was designed for total convenience. Both bedrooms have attached bathrooms with dual vanities and walk-in showers. Get cozy in the open living area furnished with beautiful tufted armchairs and a stylish mid-century modern sofa. Stream your favorite shows on the smart TV or step out onto your private balcony and watch the city unfold around you.

After a day filled with history and country music, return to the bliss of a plush bed. Sleep shouldn't be hard to come by with room-darkening shades and central air-conditioning.

Guests of this property will also have access to a shared fitness center and cornhole set.

Shared Amenities・Rooftop lounge・Fitness center・Cornhole court・Elevator in the building

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
| ▼ Important |

☑︎ A shared laundry room is available on-site. 
☑︎ The Drip Bar, located next door, is now an official Bounce luggage drop location for guest convenience.

| ▼ Things to Know |

☑︎ Check-out time: 10:00 AM

☑︎ NO smoking is permitted anywhere on the premises.
☑︎ Streaming services available with guests’ own account(s)
